channel.title: Banks & NBFCs · Market Pressure Map
channel.description: Daily news scored for its impact on Banks & NBFCs in Indian markets. Today: tailwind (+2.4).

item.title: [+2] Foreign investors buy a net ₹6,837 crore, a third straight day; domestic funds sell ₹3,679 crore (provisional)
item.description:
November foreign buying reaches about ₹9,952 crore after October's ₹52,100 crore outflow. Reversal gathering pace.

Banks & NBFCs: tailwind (+2) — Heavy foreign buying

Why it matters: Sustained foreign inflows support large caps and the rupee; domestic funds are booking profits into the rally.

Market gauges: Foreign investor flows +2, Rupee +1

Confidence: medium · horizon: days

item.title: [+1] Sensex rises 1,225 points to 76,917.85 and Nifty 1.58% to 23,810.85 for a fourth straight gain
item.description:
FMCG led sectors, with private banks and financials strong. Sensex is up about 5% in four sessions after a volatile October. Rally extending on cheaper oil and foreign buying.

Banks & NBFCs: mild tailwind (+1) — Private banks led

Why it matters: Lower crude, peace hopes and returning foreign money are lifting large caps; gains are vulnerable if Hormuz talks stall.

Market gauges: Equities (Nifty & Sensex) +2

Confidence: high · horizon: days
